nativeAcceptance.wordExportBoundary: Pages maps Arial to Arial Unicode MS and clears explicit bold/italic declarations in DOCX. Native saved source, native PDF and strict OfficeIMO DOCX retain those styles.

composedPdf.fontInputs: Repository Carlito Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic, Noto Emoji and Noto JP Common; portable deterministic PDF resource policy. ASCII Arial uses Helvetica standard fonts; Unicode footer fallback embeds Carlito Italic.
composedPdf.paginationBoundary: Native page 2 begins at body line45; composed page2 begins at46. Font metrics and pagination equivalence are not qualified.
composedPdf.rendererBoundary: Headless PDFKit thumbnail, direct Quartz and Poppler Cairo/Splash runs disagree about some repeated header/footer areas or font appearance. Native Pages and Preview UI show both areas. Retained captures identify their renderer; headless raster equivalence is unqualified.

fontProvenance: Installed Apple/Microsoft Arial fonts for native acceptance. Native PDF embeds Arial-BoldMT and Arial-ItalicMT. No standalone fonts are distributed with this fixture.
reproduction: Generate the example, run verify-pages-creation.py --page-text using the pinned descriptor, open a copy in Pages15.4, edit both areas as recorded, save/close/reopen, export PDF and Word. Run verify-pages-header-footer.py against the edited package/native Word export; run the complete pages-pdf routes with the recorded portable font profile and inspect every page.
boundaries: One uniform-style left paragraph per area only; center/right positions, mixed runs, alternate first/even pages, fields and additional sections remain unimplemented.
Creation setters require at least one character and reject zero-length text before mutation; ClearHeader and ClearFooter disable their area. Styled blank runs are outside this profile.
Loaded-source header/footer editing is not provided by the creation model.
Other native versions, fonts, scripts, wrapping and pagination contexts require separate qualification.
Native Word typography and headless rasterizer equivalence are unqualified.
Managed PDF appearance is separate from NativeAOT conversion and native creation proof.
